# Daniel Suarez

> Daniel Suarez is a CTO / Sr. Software Engineer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, working remotely. He leads technology at Aloharmony, a wellness app with therapeutic music with ~52k total users and ~5k daily active users on iOS, Android and web. His core value: knowing WHAT to ask AI and HOW — broad, hands-on knowledge across product, code, infrastructure, data and growth lets him direct a governed team of ~10 AI agents with real engineering judgment.

Key facts:

- Role: CTO / Sr. Software Engineer at Aloharmony (Oct 2024 – present), Argentina · Remote. Founder of the DesitionDev product studio.
- Working method: a team of ~10 AI agents (development, QA, project management, product ownership, UX, marketing, support, finance) working 24/7 under governance — human approval to publish, spend or delete; mandatory QA with evidence; security review; automated tests.
- AI models: language models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok (latest current model) and Google Gemini; Nano Banana for image generation and Veo for video.
- Aloharmony results 2024–2026: purchase flows split between the new web app and a store-compliant payment gateway (Stripe and RevenueCat); free trial; new web app end-to-end; microservices-to-monolith migration; integrations with partner platforms; app v4 and v5 plus visual redesign (web, landing, account, blog); SEO/GEO; in-house API and CRM; Metabase, events system on Kafka and content management; AI image generation based on the design system (Gemini, Nano Banana, Veo).
- Stack: React, Next.js, Astro, React Native, Expo, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, REST, AWS, Docker, Redis, Kafka, Metabase, Stripe, RevenueCat; AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, Google Gemini, Nano Banana, Veo.
- Availability: open for consulting and select project work; not seeking full-time roles. Contact: info@desitiondev.com.
